verses.original: וַיֵּרָ֤א אֵלָיו֙ יְהוָ֔ה בְּאֵלֹנֵ֖י מַמְרֵ֑א וְה֛וּא יֹשֵׁ֥ב פֶּֽתַח־ הָאֹ֖הֶל כְּחֹ֥ם הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·rā ’ê·lāw Yah·weh bə·’ê·lō·nê mam·rê wə·hū yō·šêḇ pe·ṯaḥ- hā·’ō·hel kə·ḥōm hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: Then the LORD appeared to Abraham by the Oaks of Mamre in the heat of the day while he was sitting at the entrance of his tent
verses.literalPt: Apareceu Jeová a Abraão junto aos terebintos de Manre, quando ele estava sentado à entrada da tenda, no calor do dia.

verses.original: וַיִּשָּׂ֤א עֵינָיו֙ וַיַּ֔רְא וְהִנֵּה֙ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה אֲנָשִׁ֔ים נִצָּבִ֖ים עָלָ֑יו וַיַּ֗רְא וַיָּ֤רָץ לִקְרָאתָם֙ מִפֶּ֣תַח הָאֹ֔הֶל וַיִּשְׁתַּ֖חוּ אָֽרְצָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·śā ‘ê·nāw way·yar wə·hin·nêh šə·lō·šāh ’ă·nā·šîm niṣ·ṣā·ḇîm ‘ā·lāw way·yar way·yā·rāṣ liq·rā·ṯām mip·pe·ṯaḥ hā·’ō·hel way·yiš·ta·ḥū ’ā·rə·ṣāh
verses.literal: And Abraham looked up . . . and saw . . . three men standing nearby When he saw them he ran from the entrance of his tent to meet them and bowed low to the ground
verses.literalPt: Tendo ele levantado os olhos, olhou, e eis que três homens estavam de pé em frente dele; quando os viu, correu da entrada da tenda para os receber, prostrou-se em terra

verses.original: וַיֹּאמַ֑ר אֲדֹנָ֗י אִם־ נָ֨א מָצָ֤אתִי חֵן֙ בְּעֵינֶ֔יךָ אַל־ נָ֥א תַעֲבֹ֖ר מֵעַ֥ל עַבְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy ’im- nā mā·ṣā·ṯî ḥên bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā ’al- nā ṯa·‘ă·ḇōr mê·‘al ‘aḇ·de·ḵā
verses.literal: My lord said Abraham if I have found favor in your sight please do not . . . pass . . . your servant by
verses.literalPt: e disse: Senhor meu, se tenho achado graça nos teus olhos, rogo-te que não passes de teu servo:

verses.original: יֻקַּֽח־ נָ֣א מְעַט־ מַ֔יִם וְרַחֲצ֖וּ רַגְלֵיכֶ֑ם וְהִֽשָּׁעֲנ֖וּ תַּ֥חַת הָעֵֽץ׃
verses.transliteration: yuq·qaḥ- nā mə·‘aṭ- ma·yim wə·ra·ḥă·ṣū raḡ·lê·ḵem wə·hiš·šā·‘ă·nū ta·ḥaṯ hā·‘êṣ
verses.literal: Let a little water be brought . . . that you may wash your feet and rest yourselves under the tree
verses.literalPt: que seja trazida um pouco de água, lavai os pés e reclinai-vos debaixo da árvore;

verses.original: וְאֶקְחָ֨ה פַת־ לֶ֜חֶם וְסַעֲד֤וּ לִבְּכֶם֙ אַחַ֣ר תַּעֲבֹ֔רוּ כִּֽי־ עַל־ כֵּ֥ן עֲבַרְתֶּ֖ם עַֽל־ עַבְדְּכֶ֑ם וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ כֵּ֥ן תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּֽרְתָּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eq·ḥāh p̄aṯ- le·ḥem wə·sa·‘ă·ḏū lib·bə·ḵem ’a·ḥar ta·‘ă·ḇō·rū kî- ‘al- kên ‘ă·ḇar·tem ‘al- ‘aḇ·də·ḵem way·yō·mə·rū kên ta·‘ă·śeh ka·’ă·šer dib·bar·tā
verses.literal: And I will bring a bit of bread so that you may refresh yourselves This is why . . . . . . you have passed your servant’s way After that you may continue on your way . . . Yes they replied you may do as you have said
verses.literalPt: trarei um bocado de pão, e confortai o vosso coração; depois, ireis adiante, pois, por isso chegastes ao vosso servo. Responderam: Faze assim como disseste.

verses.original: וַיְמַהֵ֧ר אַבְרָהָ֛ם הָאֹ֖הֱלָה אֶל־ שָׂרָ֑ה וַיֹּ֗אמֶר מַהֲרִ֞י שְׁלֹ֤שׁ סְאִים֙ קֶ֣מַח סֹ֔לֶת ל֖וּשִׁי וַעֲשִׂ֥י עֻגֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·ma·hêr ’aḇ·rā·hām hā·’ō·hĕ·lāh ’el- śā·rāh way·yō·mer ma·hă·rî šə·lōš sə·’îm qe·maḥ sō·leṯ lū·šî wa·‘ă·śî ‘u·ḡō·wṯ
verses.literal: So Abraham hurried into the tent and said to Sarah Quick! Prepare three seahs of fine flour knead it and bake some bread
verses.literalPt: Apressou-se Abraão em entrar na tenda a ter com Sara e disse: Amassa depressa três medidas de flor de farinha e faze pão assado ao borralho.

verses.original: וְאֶל־ הַבָּקָ֖ר רָ֣ץ אַבְרָהָ֑ם וַיִּקַּ֨ח בֶּן־ בָּקָ֜ר רַ֤ךְ וָטוֹב֙ וַיִּתֵּ֣ן אֶל־ הַנַּ֔עַר וַיְמַהֵ֖ר לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’el- hab·bā·qār rāṣ ’aḇ·rā·hām way·yiq·qaḥ ben- bā·qār raḵ wā·ṭō·wḇ way·yit·tên ’el- han·na·‘ar way·ma·hêr la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: Meanwhile, Abraham ran to the herd selected a tender and choice calf . . . and gave it to a servant who hurried to prepare it
verses.literalPt: Correu Abraão ao gado, tomou um bezerro tenro e bom e deu-o ao criado, que se apressou em prepará-lo.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח חֶמְאָ֜ה וְחָלָ֗ב וּבֶן־ הַבָּקָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה וַיִּתֵּ֖ן לִפְנֵיהֶ֑ם וְהֽוּא־ עֹמֵ֧ד עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם תַּ֥חַת הָעֵ֖ץ וַיֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ ḥem·’āh wə·ḥā·lāḇ ū·ḇen- hab·bā·qār ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh way·yit·tên lip̄·nê·hem wə·hū- ‘ō·mêḏ ‘ă·lê·hem ta·ḥaṯ hā·‘êṣ way·yō·ḵê·lū
verses.literal: Then Abraham brought curds and milk and the calf . . . that had been prepared and he set them before the men and stood by them under the tree as they ate
verses.literalPt: Então, tomou leite azedo, e leite fresco, e o bezerro que mandara preparar e pôs tudo diante deles. Ficou de pé ao lado deles debaixo da árvore, e eles comeram.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵׄלָׄ֔יׄוׄ אַיֵּ֖ה שָׂרָ֣ה אִשְׁתֶּ֑ךָ וַיֹּ֖אמֶר הִנֵּ֥ה בָאֹֽהֶל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ʾē·lå̄w ’ay·yêh śā·rāh ’iš·te·ḵā way·yō·mer hin·nêh ḇā·’ō·hel
verses.literal: Where is your wife Sarah they asked . . . There in the tent he replied
verses.literalPt: Eles lhe perguntaram: Onde está Sara, tua mulher? Respondeu ele: Ela está na tenda.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר שׁ֣וֹב אָשׁ֤וּב אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ כָּעֵ֣ת חַיָּ֔ה וְהִנֵּה־ בֵ֖ן לְשָׂרָ֣ה אִשְׁתֶּ֑ךָ וְשָׂרָ֥ה שֹׁמַ֛עַת פֶּ֥תַח הָאֹ֖הֶל וְה֥וּא אַחֲרָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šō·wḇ ’ā·šūḇ ’ê·le·ḵā kā·‘êṯ ḥay·yāh wə·hin·nêh- ḇên lə·śā·rāh ’iš·te·ḵā wə·śā·rāh šō·ma·‘aṯ pe·ṯaḥ hā·’ō·hel wə·hū ’a·ḥă·rāw
verses.literal: Then the LORD said I will surely return . . . to you at this time next year . . . . . . and your wife Sarah will have a son Now Sarah . . . was behind him listening at the entrance to the tent
verses.literalPt: Disse um deles: Certamente, voltarei a ti daqui a um ano; e Sara, tua mulher, terá um filho. Ouviu-o Sara à entrada da tenda, que estava atrás dele.

verses.original: וְאַבְרָהָ֤ם וְשָׂרָה֙ זְקֵנִ֔ים בָּאִ֖ים בַּיָּמִ֑ים חָדַל֙ לִהְי֣וֹת לְשָׂרָ֔ה אֹ֖רַח כַּנָּשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’aḇ·rā·hām wə·śā·rāh zə·qê·nîm bā·’îm bay·yā·mîm ḥā·ḏal lih·yō·wṯ lə·śā·rāh ’ō·raḥ kan·nā·šîm
verses.literal: And Abraham and Sarah were already old and well along in years Sarah had passed . . . the age of childbearing . . .
verses.literalPt: Ora, Abraão e Sara eram já velhos e de idade avançada; e a Sara tinha cessado o costume das mulheres.

verses.original: וַתִּצְחַ֥ק שָׂרָ֖ה בְּקִרְבָּ֣הּ לֵאמֹ֑ר אַחֲרֵ֤י בְלֹתִי֙ הָֽיְתָה־ לִּ֣י עֶדְנָ֔ה וַֽאדֹנִ֖י זָקֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiṣ·ḥaq śā·rāh bə·qir·bāh lê·mōr ’a·ḥă·rê ḇə·lō·ṯî hā·yə·ṯāh- lî ‘eḏ·nāh wa·ḏō·nî zā·qên
verses.literal: So she laughed to herself saying After I am worn out and my master is old will I now have . . . this pleasure
verses.literalPt: Assim, riu-se Sara consigo, dizendo: Terei prazer, depois de envelhecida, sendo também velho o meu senhor?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ אַבְרָהָ֑ם לָ֣מָּה זֶּה֩ צָחֲקָ֨ה שָׂרָ֜ה לֵאמֹ֗ר הַאַ֥ף אֻמְנָ֛ם אֵלֵ֖ד וַאֲנִ֥י זָקַֽנְתִּי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- ’aḇ·rā·hām lām·māh zeh ṣā·ḥă·qāh śā·rāh lê·mōr ha·’ap̄ ’um·nām ’ê·lêḏ wa·’ă·nî zā·qan·tî
verses.literal: And the LORD . . . asked Abraham Why . . . did Sarah laugh and say Can I really . . . bear a child when I am old
verses.literalPt: Perguntou Jeová a Abraão: Porque se riu Sara, dizendo: É verdade que eu, que sou velha, darei à luz um filho?

verses.original: הֲיִפָּלֵ֥א מֵיְהוָ֖ה דָּבָ֑ר לַמּוֹעֵ֞ד אָשׁ֥וּב אֵלֶ֛יךָ כָּעֵ֥ת חַיָּ֖ה וּלְשָׂרָ֥ה בֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: hă·yip·pā·lê Yah·weh dā·ḇār lam·mō·w·‘êḏ ’ā·šūḇ ’ê·le·ḵā kā·‘êṯ ḥay·yāh ū·lə·śā·rāh ḇên
verses.literal: Is anything too difficult for the LORD At the appointed time I will return to you in about a year . . . and Sarah will have a son
verses.literalPt: Há, porventura, alguma coisa que seja demasiadamente difícil a Jeová? Ao tempo determinado, daqui a um ano, voltarei a ti, e Sara terá um filho.

verses.original: וַתְּכַחֵ֨שׁ שָׂרָ֧ה׀ לֵאמֹ֛ר לֹ֥א צָחַ֖קְתִּי כִּ֣י׀ יָרֵ֑אָה וַיֹּ֥אמֶר׀ לֹ֖א כִּ֥י צָחָֽקְתְּ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tə·ḵa·ḥêš śā·rāh lê·mōr lō ṣā·ḥaq·tî kî yā·rê·’āh way·yō·mer lō kî ṣā·ḥā·qət
verses.literal: But Sarah was afraid so she denied it and said “I did not laugh No replied the LORD but you did laugh
verses.literalPt: Então, Sara, porque teve medo, o negou, dizendo: Não me ri. Mas ele disse: Não é assim; pois tu te riste.

verses.original: וַיָּקֻ֤מוּ מִשָּׁם֙ הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים וַיַּשְׁקִ֖פוּ עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י סְדֹ֑ם וְאַ֨בְרָהָ֔ם הֹלֵ֥ךְ עִמָּ֖ם לְשַׁלְּחָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qu·mū miš·šām hā·’ă·nā·šîm way·yaš·qi·p̄ū ‘al- pə·nê sə·ḏōm wə·’aḇ·rā·hām hō·lêḵ ‘im·mām lə·šal·lə·ḥām
verses.literal: When the men got up to leave they looked out over . . . Sodom and Abraham walked along with them to see them off
verses.literalPt: Tendo-se levantado dali os homens, olharam para Sodoma; e Abraão ia com eles para os encaminhar.

verses.original: וַֽיהֹוָ֖ה אָמָ֑ר הַֽמְכַסֶּ֤ה אֲנִי֙ מֵֽאַבְרָהָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֲנִ֥י עֹשֶֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’ā·mār ham·ḵas·seh ’ă·nî mê·’aḇ·rā·hām ’ă·šer ’ă·nî ‘ō·śeh
verses.literal: And the LORD said Shall I hide from Abraham what I am about to do
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová: Ocultarei eu a Abraão o que faço;

verses.original: וְאַ֨בְרָהָ֔ם הָי֧וֹ יִֽהְיֶ֛ה לְג֥וֹי גָּד֖וֹל וְעָצ֑וּם וְנִ֨בְרְכוּ ב֔וֹ כֹּ֖ל גּוֹיֵ֥י הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’aḇ·rā·hām hā·yōw yih·yeh lə·ḡō·w gā·ḏō·wl wə·‘ā·ṣūm wə·niḇ·rə·ḵū ḇōw kōl gō·w·yê hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Abraham will surely become . . . a great and powerful nation and through him all the nations of the earth will be blessed
verses.literalPt: visto que Abraão, certamente, virá a ser uma grande e poderosa nação, e por meio dele serão benditas todas as nações da terra?

verses.original: כִּ֣י יְדַעְתִּ֗יו לְמַעַן֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְצַוֶּ֜ה אֶת־ בָּנָ֤יו וְאֶת־ בֵּיתוֹ֙ אַחֲרָ֔יו וְשָֽׁמְרוּ֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יְהוָ֔ה לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת צְדָקָ֖ה וּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט לְמַ֗עַן הָבִ֤יא יְהוָה֙ עַל־ אַבְרָהָ֔ם אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבֶּ֖ר עָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: kî yə·ḏa‘·tîw lə·ma·‘an ’ă·šer yə·ṣaw·weh ’eṯ- bā·nāw wə·’eṯ- bê·ṯōw ’a·ḥă·rāw wə·šā·mə·rū de·reḵ Yah·weh la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ṣə·ḏā·qāh ū·miš·pāṭ lə·ma·‘an hā·ḇî Yah·weh ‘al- ’aḇ·rā·hām ’êṯ ’ă·šer- dib·ber ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: For I have chosen him so that he will command his children and his household after him to keep the way of the LORD by doing what is right and just in order that the LORD may bring upon Abraham what He has promised
verses.literalPt: Porque o tenho conhecido, a fim de que ordene a seus filhos e a sua casa depois dele que guardem o caminho de Jeová, para praticarem a justiça e o juízo; a fim de que Jeová faça vir sobre Abraão o que a respeito dele tem falado.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֔ה זַעֲקַ֛ת סְדֹ֥ם וַעֲמֹרָ֖ה כִּי־ רָ֑בָּה וְחַ֨טָּאתָ֔ם כִּ֥י כָבְדָ֖ה מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh za·‘ă·qaṯ sə·ḏōm wa·‘ă·mō·rāh kî- rāb·bāh wə·ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯām kî ḵā·ḇə·ḏāh mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: Then the LORD said The outcry against Sodom and Gomorrah is great Because their sin is so grievous
verses.literalPt: Disse mais Jeová: Em verdade, o clamor de Sodoma e Gomorra tem-se multiplicado, e o seu pecado tem-se agravado muito;

verses.original: אֵֽרֲדָה־ נָּ֣א וְאֶרְאֶ֔ה הַכְּצַעֲקָתָ֛הּ הַבָּ֥אָה אֵלַ֖י עָשׂ֣וּ׀ כָּלָ֑ה וְאִם־ לֹ֖א אֵדָֽעָה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ê·ră·ḏāh- nā wə·’er·’eh hak·kə·ṣa·‘ă·qā·ṯāh hab·bā·’āh ’ê·lay ‘ā·śū kā·lāh wə·’im- lō ’ê·ḏā·‘āh
verses.literal: I will go down . . . to see if their actions fully justify the outcry that has reached Me If not I will find out
verses.literalPt: descerei e verei se em tudo têm praticado segundo o seu clamor, que é chegado a mim; e, se assim não é, sabê-lo-ei.

verses.original: וַיִּפְנ֤וּ מִשָּׁם֙ הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים וַיֵּלְכ֖וּ סְדֹ֑מָה וְאַ֨בְרָהָ֔ם עוֹדֶ֥נּוּ עֹמֵ֖ד לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yip̄·nū miš·šām hā·’ă·nā·šîm way·yê·lə·ḵū sə·ḏō·māh wə·’aḇ·rā·hām ‘ō·w·ḏen·nū ‘ō·mêḏ lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: And the two men turned away and went toward Sodom but Abraham remained standing before the LORD
verses.literalPt: Então, os homens voltaram dali os seus rostos, e foram em direção a Sodoma; porém Abraão ficou ainda em pé diante de Jeová.

verses.original: וַיִּגַּ֥שׁ אַבְרָהָ֖ם וַיֹּאמַ֑ר הַאַ֣ף תִּסְפֶּ֔ה צַדִּ֖יק עִם־ רָשָֽׁע׃
verses.transliteration: way·yig·gaš ’aḇ·rā·hām way·yō·mar ha·’ap̄ tis·peh ṣad·dîq ‘im- rā·šā‘
verses.literal: Abraham stepped forward and said Will You really sweep away the righteous with the wicked
verses.literalPt: Chegando-se Abraão, disse: Hás de perder os justos com os ímpios?

verses.original: אוּלַ֥י יֵ֛שׁ חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים צַדִּיקִ֖ם בְּת֣וֹךְ הָעִ֑יר הַאַ֤ף תִּסְפֶּה֙ וְלֹא־ תִשָּׂ֣א לַמָּק֔וֹם לְמַ֛עַן חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים הַצַּדִּיקִ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּקִרְבָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ū·lay yêš ḥă·miš·šîm ṣad·dî·qim bə·ṯō·wḵ hā·‘îr ha·’ap̄ tis·peh wə·lō- ṯiś·śā lam·mā·qō·wm lə·ma·‘an ḥă·miš·šîm haṣ·ṣad·dî·qim ’ă·šer bə·qir·bāh
verses.literal: What if there are fifty righteous ones in the city Will You really sweep it away and not spare the place for the sake of the fifty righteous ones who are there
verses.literalPt: Há, talvez, cinquenta justos dentro da cidade; destruirás e não pouparás o lugar por amor dos cinquenta justos que estão ali?

verses.original: חָלִ֨לָה לְּךָ֜ מֵעֲשֹׂ֣ת׀ כַּדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֗ה לְהָמִ֤ית צַדִּיק֙ עִם־ רָשָׁ֔ע וְהָיָ֥ה כַצַּדִּ֖יק כָּרָשָׁ֑ע חָלִ֣לָה לָּ֔ךְ הֲשֹׁפֵט֙ כָּל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ לֹ֥א יַעֲשֶׂ֖ה מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·li·lāh lə·ḵā mê·‘ă·śōṯ kad·dā·ḇār haz·zeh lə·hā·mîṯ ṣad·dîq ‘im- rā·šā‘ wə·hā·yāh ḵaṣ·ṣad·dîq kā·rā·šā‘ ḥā·li·lāh lāḵ hă·šō·p̄êṭ kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ lō ya·‘ă·śeh miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: Far be it from You to do such a thing to kill the righteous with the wicked so that the righteous and the wicked are treated alike Far be it from You Will not the Judge of all the earth do what is right
verses.literalPt: Longe de ti fazeres tal coisa, que mates os justos com os ímpios, de sorte que sejam os justos como os ímpios; seja isto longe de ti: não fará justiça o Juiz de toda a terra?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֔ה אִם־ אֶמְצָ֥א בִסְדֹ֛ם חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים צַדִּיקִ֖ם בְּת֣וֹךְ הָעִ֑יר וְנָשָׂ֥אתִי לְכָל־ הַמָּק֖וֹם בַּעֲבוּרָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’im- ’em·ṣā ḇis·ḏōm ḥă·miš·šîm ṣad·dî·qim bə·ṯō·wḵ hā·‘îr wə·nā·śā·ṯî lə·ḵāl ham·mā·qō·wm ba·‘ă·ḇū·rām
verses.literal: So the LORD replied If I find fifty righteous ones within the city of Sodom on their account I will spare the whole place
verses.literalPt: Respondeu Jeová: Se eu achar em Sodoma cinquenta justos dentro da cidade, perdoarei o lugar todo por amor deles.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַן אַבְרָהָ֖ם וַיֹּאמַ֑ר הִנֵּה־ נָ֤א הוֹאַ֙לְתִּי֙ לְדַבֵּ֣ר אֶל־ אֲדֹנָ֔י וְאָנֹכִ֖י עָפָ֥ר וָאֵֽפֶר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an ’aḇ·rā·hām way·yō·mar hin·nêh- nā hō·w·’al·tî lə·ḏab·bêr ’el- ’ă·ḏō·nāy wə·’ā·nō·ḵî ‘ā·p̄ār wā·’ê·p̄er
verses.literal: Then Abraham answered Now that . . . I have ventured to speak to the Lord though I am but dust and ashes
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe mais Abraão: Eis que tomei a liberdade de falar ao Senhor, ainda que sou pó e cinza:

verses.original: א֠וּלַי יַחְסְר֞וּן חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים הַצַּדִּיקִם֙ חֲמִשָּׁ֔ה הֲתַשְׁחִ֥ית בַּחֲמִשָּׁ֖ה אֶת־ כָּל־ הָעִ֑יר וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לֹ֣א אַשְׁחִ֔ית אִם־ אֶמְצָ֣א שָׁ֔ם אַרְבָּעִ֖ים וַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ū·lay yaḥ·sə·rūn ḥă·miš·šîm haṣ·ṣad·dî·qim ḥă·miš·šāh hă·ṯaš·ḥîṯ ba·ḥă·miš·šāh ’eṯ- kāl- hā·‘îr way·yō·mer lō ’aš·ḥîṯ ’im- ’em·ṣā šām ’ar·bā·‘îm wa·ḥă·miš·šāh
verses.literal: suppose the fifty righteous ones lack five Will You destroy the whole city for the lack of five He replied If I find forty-five . . . there I will not destroy it
verses.literalPt: porventura, faltarão cinco para os cinquenta justos; destruirás toda a cidade porque lhe faltam estes cinco? Respondeu ele: Não a destruirei, se achar ali quarenta e cinco.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨סֶף ע֜וֹד לְדַבֵּ֤ר אֵלָיו֙ וַיֹּאמַ֔ר אוּלַ֛י יִמָּצְא֥וּן שָׁ֖ם אַרְבָּעִ֑ים וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לֹ֣א אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֔ה בַּעֲב֖וּר הָאַרְבָּעִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·sep̄ ‘ō·wḏ lə·ḏab·bêr ’ê·lāw way·yō·mar ’ū·lay yim·mā·ṣə·’ūn šām ’ar·bā·‘îm way·yō·mer lō ’e·‘ĕ·śeh ba·‘ă·ḇūr hā·’ar·bā·‘îm
verses.literal: Once again . . . Abraham spoke to the LORD Suppose forty . . . are found there He answered On account of the forty I will not do it
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe ainda mais Abraão: Porventura, se acharão ali quarenta. Respondeu ele: Não o farei por amor dos quarenta.

verses.original: וַ֠יֹּאמֶר אַל־ נָ֞א יִ֤חַר לַֽאדֹנָי֙ וַאֲדַבֵּ֔רָה אוּלַ֛י יִמָּצְא֥וּן שָׁ֖ם שְׁלֹשִׁ֑ים וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לֹ֣א אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֔ה אִם־ אֶמְצָ֥א שָׁ֖ם שְׁלֹשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’al- nā yi·ḥar la·ḏō·nāy wa·’ă·ḏab·bê·rāh ’ū·lay yim·mā·ṣə·’ūn šām šə·lō·šîm way·yō·mer lō ’e·‘ĕ·śeh ’im- ’em·ṣā šām šə·lō·šîm
verses.literal: Then Abraham said May the Lord not . . . be angry but let me speak further Suppose thirty are found there He replied If I find thirty there I will not do it
verses.literalPt: Disse Abraão: Não se ire o Senhor, e falarei; porventura, achar-se-ão ali trinta. Respondeu o Senhor: Não o farei, se eu achar ali trinta.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הִנֵּֽה־ נָ֤א הוֹאַ֙לְתִּי֙ לְדַבֵּ֣ר אֶל־ אֲדֹנָ֔י אוּלַ֛י יִמָּצְא֥וּן שָׁ֖ם עֶשְׂרִ֑ים וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לֹ֣א אַשְׁחִ֔ית בַּעֲב֖וּר הָֽעֶשְׂרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer hin·nêh- nā hō·w·’al·tî lə·ḏab·bêr ’el- ’ă·ḏō·nāy ’ū·lay yim·mā·ṣə·’ūn šām ‘eś·rîm way·yō·mer lō ’aš·ḥîṯ ba·‘ă·ḇūr hā·‘eś·rîm
verses.literal: And Abraham said Now that . . . I have ventured to speak to the Lord suppose twenty are found there He answered On account of the twenty I will not destroy it
verses.literalPt: Disse Abraão: Eis que tomei a liberdade de falar ao Senhor; porventura, achar-se-ão ali vinte. Respondeu o Senhor: Não a destruirei por amor dos vinte.

verses.original: וַ֠יֹּאמֶר אַל־ נָ֞א יִ֤חַר לַֽאדֹנָי֙ וַאֲדַבְּרָ֣ה אַךְ־ הַפַּ֔עַם אוּלַ֛י יִמָּצְא֥וּן שָׁ֖ם עֲשָׂרָ֑ה וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לֹ֣א אַשְׁחִ֔ית בַּעֲב֖וּר הָעֲשָׂרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’al- nā yi·ḥar la·ḏō·nāy wa·’ă·ḏab·bə·rāh ’aḵ- hap·pa·‘am ’ū·lay yim·mā·ṣə·’ūn šām ‘ă·śā·rāh way·yō·mer lō ’aš·ḥîṯ ba·‘ă·ḇūr hā·‘ă·śā·rāh
verses.literal: Finally, Abraham said May the Lord not . . . be angry but let me speak . . . once more Suppose ten are found there And He answered On account of the ten I will not destroy it
verses.literalPt: Disse Abraão: Não se ire o Senhor, e ainda falarei somente esta vez; porventura, achar-se-ão ali dez. Respondeu o Senhor: Não a destruirei por amor dos dez.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ יְהוָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר כִּלָּ֔ה לְדַבֵּ֖ר אֶל־ אַבְרָהָ֑ם וְאַבְרָהָ֖ם שָׁ֥ב לִמְקֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ Yah·weh ka·’ă·šer kil·lāh lə·ḏab·bêr ’el- ’aḇ·rā·hām wə·’aḇ·rā·hām šāḇ lim·qō·mōw
verses.literal: When the LORD had finished speaking with Abraham He departed and Abraham returned home
verses.literalPt: Foi-se Jeová logo que acabou de falar com Abraão; e Abraão voltou para o seu lugar.
